purpose: Independent scope peer review of GDT298 lexicalized hybrid architecture and V55 R3 lookup model.

models.scope: GDT298 selects a high-capacity joint (PAGE_HOST, renderer) surface-form lexicon with reusable record/frame constraints as backoff. GDT297 establishes 59/59 exact-host renderer/form bijections; GDT289–290 reject the tested compact cross-host/latent-class transfers; GDT299 supplies a held-folio whole-form physical-position signal. These support architecture selection, not a word, cipher, language, or meaning claim.

exact_quotes.text: This is a YOLO abductive synthesis, not a new manuscript score or a confirmation experiment.
GDT297 shows a within-host bijection between every exact renderer tuple and complete source form, while GDT289--290 fail to transfer a compact renderer across unseen hosts.
Held-folio opaque whole-form physical-line placement only; no word morphology function semantic role code value language meaning plaintext or translation.

models.correction: Do not describe compact transfer as generally disproven or all cipher hypotheses as rejected. The evidence selects the current formal representation and leaves the semantic endpoint unbound; the report explicitly says the decisive repeated referent transfer does not exist.

models.scope: V55 R3 gives an executable local lookup notation for f67r2, f68r1, and f69v and preserves separate namespaces. Its station/lookup model wins that report's qualitative comparison, but the technical content is creatively supplemented and the f68↔f69 28-slot join is explicitly unlicensed. This is underdetermination/scope control, not an empirical failure of every lookup model.

exact_quotes.text: Die drei Diagramme arbeiten am sparsamsten als drei lokale Nachschlageinstrumente mit getrennten Namensräumen
Vollständigkeit beweist deshalb gerade keine Semantik.

models.correction: Reject only the forced cross-diagram index pairing and unbound content glosses. Retain the report's narrower lookup notation as a creative, underidentified model; no global missing-data claim follows.

peer_conclusion: GDT298 is a formal model-choice result with a still-missing semantic endpoint. V55 is a bounded executable lookup proposal whose shared 28-slot join lacks a license; neither source supports a decipherment claim.
